models.label: Ideal series-parallel scaling of identical cells
assumptions: All cells identical (cell-to-cell variation is handled separately in the variation module).
Interconnect resistance excluded here; see mechanical busbar estimate.

models.label: Nominal-voltage energy and ohmic power estimate
assumptions: OCV taken as nominal voltage over the whole SOC window (OCV–SOC curve ignored).
Resistance constant with SOC and temperature.
Usable energy excludes conversion losses; see the time-domain simulation for rate-dependent energy.

models.label: Ideal coulomb-counting time estimates
assumptions: Charge time covers the constant-current phase only; the constant-voltage tail is ignored.
100 % coulombic efficiency; capacity independent of rate and temperature.

models.label: 1-RC equivalent-circuit model with CC-CV charge, coupled lumped thermal node
equations: CP: r_eff·I² − (OCV−V1)·I + P_cell = 0, r_eff = R0 + R_ic·P/S
assumptions: All cells identical; equal current sharing in parallel groups.
R0, R1, C1 constant with SOC, temperature and current direction.
OCV from the cell's OCV–SOC table (linear interpolation); hysteresis ignored.
100 % coulombic efficiency; no self-discharge.
Thermal: single lumped node per cell (see thermal model limitations).

models.label: SIMPLIFIED lumped single-node thermal model per cell
assumptions: Each cell is one isothermal node; no cell-to-cell heat sharing, so centre/edge spread is not modelled.
Only irreversible I²R0 heat; entropic heat and RC polarisation heat excluded in the closed form.
R0 constant with temperature and SOC.
Cooling reduced to one lumped thermal resistance to ambient; ambient constant.
Cells start at ambient temperature.

models.label: SIMPLIFIED linear ageing assumption (not a degradation model)
assumptions: Linear fade with cycle count; real fade is non-linear and condition-dependent.
Datasheet cycle life applies only under the datasheet's own test conditions.
Calendar ageing, temperature, C-rate and DoD effects are not modelled.

models.label: Deterministic limit, protection-coordination and sensing checks
equations: I_safe = max I s.t. all limits hold (brentq)
assumptions: Checks screen the design against stated limits; they are not a safety certification.
Fuse time–current characteristics and BMS response times are not modelled.
Temperature checks use the simplified lumped thermal estimate.

models.label: Rectangular-grid envelope, mass roll-up and busbar sizing
assumptions: Rectangular grid, no honeycomb nesting; housing modelled as uniform walls.
Busbars: series links between adjacent rows only; parallel collectors, terminals and wiring excluded.
Material properties at 20 °C; busbar temperature rise not checked.

models.label: Bill-of-materials cost roll-up and relative cost index
equations: C = N·(c_cell + c_cool) + c_BMS + c_housing + c_other
assumptions: Component prices are user inputs; no market prices are built in.
Assembly labour, testing, logistics, taxes and volume discounts excluded.

models.label: Monte-Carlo cell tolerance propagation (closed-form models)
assumptions: Normal, independent capacity and resistance variation with the given tolerances.
Static current split by resistance only (OCV differences ignored).
No thermal coupling between cells.

models.label: Constraint-first, weighted normalised multi-criteria comparison
assumptions: Min–max normalisation is relative to the compared set only; adding a design can change scores.
Weights express user preference and are not engineering facts.
Scores inherit every limitation of the underlying simplified models.
